format: UTF-8; JSONL: one entity/fact per line
districtAssociationMeaning: county/district evidence only; NOT a campus address or coordinate
zoneDistrictMappingMeaning: government-backed functional-zone aliases may fill campus d only when province/city match and exactly one mapping term matches; mappings target the lowest legal county/district, not the functional-zone label
entityStatusMeaning: historical/legal school entities may remain searchable for audit while rankingEligible=false removes them from current province/city/district candidate ranking
cityRankingMeaning: a university entity competes only in its single host city; physical campuses in other cities do not replace that city's host-university label

cityAffiliateTiers.undergraduate: external university campus/branch with undergraduate admission or undergraduate education in the city
cityAffiliateTiers.graduate: external graduate school/institute or graduate education base; does not compete for the city main label

institutionFacts.meaning: rankings/admissions/finance are versioned facts; no changing metric is treated as a permanent university attribute

admissionBatchRule: 一本/二本/本科批 are province-and-year admission facts, not intrinsic school levels; school level remains undergraduate/vocational/adult as defined by registry data
rankingRule: category rank is not a national rank; use publisher-supplied reference rank for cross-category comparison when available; missing external rank is unknown, never zero/worst by imputation
geography: p/c/d = province/city/district; empty d = unresolved county, NOT city centre
geometryEncoding: gzip JSON; rows [adcode,name,center,level,childrenNum,encodedRings]; delta polyline integers / 1000
